newsitem.title: USA: Bacou to buy Survivair but not Interspiro.
newsitem.headline: Bacou to buy Survivair but not Interspiro.

text.p: Safety eyewear maker Bacou USA Inc said Monday it had definitively agreed to acquire Survivair Inc, a maker of respiratory products based in Santa Ana, California, for $27.4 million, subject to adjustments and the assumption of certain liabilities.
Separately, the company said it did not expect to complete its proposed purchase of the Interspiro group of companies headquartered in Lidingo, Sweden.

Bacou had proposed buying Interspiro, a maker of breathing equipment for firefighters and divers, in December. It did not say why it did not expect the acquisition to proceed and attempts to reach the company were not immediately successful.
Bacou said in a release that the Survivair purchase would make it one of the top five makers of respiratory protection products in the United States.
Survivair had total sales of $29.6 million for its fiscal year ended December 31, Bacou said.
It said it expects the Survivair deal to close in May.
